title: Create: Mega
description: This modpack is a combined survival Create experience
body:
Take the Create experience to the next level with a massive collection of Create add-ons, quality-of-life improvements, and performance enhancements.

This modpack is built around the Create ecosystem, expanding automation, engineering, transportation, logistics, power generation, and factory building with a carefully selected lineup of Create-compatible mods. Design sprawling industrial complexes, construct advanced production lines, and automate nearly every aspect of your world.

Features
Extensive collection of Create add-ons
Expanded machinery, automation, and factory progression
New tools, components, and engineering possibilities
Enhanced transportation and logistics systems
Optimized performance for smoother gameplay
Improved loading times and reduced lag
Multiplayer-friendly configuration

Whether you're a veteran engineer or new to Create, this pack offers countless opportunities to build, automate, and innovate while maintaining excellent performance and stability.

Build bigger. Automate smarter. Create without limits.
